QIR: Detect indicators of third-party partner account compromise targeting ApexCode's GitHub, Jira, and Okta environments. Threat actors are using session hijacking via proxy phishing tools (Evilginx2) to steal partner employee session cookies and bypass MFA.
Threat Context: Third-party dev partners have privileged access to GitHub, Jira, Okta. Adversaries use Evilginx2 to steal session cookies via AiTM proxy phishing. No new IdP login event — session reuse is the evasion technique.
Essential Sources: Okta System Log; Microsoft Entra ID Sign-In Logs; GitHub Audit Log; Proofpoint Email Security
Useful Sources: Jira Audit Log; CrowdStrike Falcon; Palo Alto Networks Firewall (PAN-OS); Microsoft Sentinel; HaveIBeenPwned API; SpyCloud; urlscan.io; dnstwist; PhishTank / CheckPhish
Priority Signal: Active Okta/Entra session (externalSessionId / session token) exercised from a new IP, ASN, device, or user-agent mid-session — the same authenticated session appearing from a new origin (session-cookie replay).

QIR: Detect ransomware initial access via stolen VPN/RDP credentials against on-premises jump hosts and cloud workloads.
Threat Context: Ransomware operators purchase VPN/RDP credentials from initial access brokers. They authenticate to the corporate VPN, pivot to jump hosts, then deploy ransomware across accessible systems.
Essential Sources: Okta System Log; Microsoft Entra ID Sign-In Logs; CrowdStrike Falcon; Palo Alto Networks Firewall (PAN-OS)
Useful Sources: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint; AWS CloudTrail; Azure Activity Log; CyberArk Privileged Access Manager; HaveIBeenPwned API; DeHashed; GreyNoise
Priority Signal: VPN authentication from a new IP/device for a service or admin account, followed by RDP lateral movement within 1 hour.

QIR: Detect BEC involving Microsoft 365 mail rules, inbox forwarding, and OAuth consent grant abuse.
Threat Context: Attacker compromises an M365 account, creates inbox forwarding rules to exfiltrate email, and grants OAuth consent to a malicious app for persistent access to mailbox and OneDrive data.
Essential Sources: Microsoft 365 Unified Audit Log; Microsoft Entra ID Audit Logs; Microsoft Entra ID Sign-In Logs; Proofpoint Email Security
Useful Sources: Microsoft Sentinel; Okta System Log; Cisco Umbrella; HaveIBeenPwned API; PhishTank / CheckPhish
Priority Signal: New-InboxRule creating a forwarding rule to an external address, combined with OAuth consent grant to an unrecognized application within 24 hours.
